meta.name: add-mnemon
meta.description: Add persistent graph-based memory via mnemon. Agents recall past context before responding and remember insights after each turn.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体记住每次对话，自动回忆历史并沉淀洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在开发智能体，需要让它记住多轮对话的关键信息
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building AI agents that need to remember context across conversations.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude在每次回复前会先查看记忆库,把相关过往内容带出来;每轮对话结束会把新得到的信息存进去。记忆保存在每个agent组自己的目录里,容器重启也不会丢。
howto.when: 当你在对话中提到之前聊过的事情,或开始新会话时,Claude会自动调出相关记忆;每轮对话后它也会自动记录新信息。注意仅在使用默认Claude provider的agent上生效。

say.text: 我们上次讨论了XX项目的架构,接着说。
say.note: 这会触发Claude调出之前的记忆。

say.text: 根据我上周说过的偏好,推荐一下方案。
say.note: Claude会从记忆库中检索相关上下文。

say.text: 我刚才跟你提过那件事,你还记得吗?

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude checks the memory store before each reply and surfaces relevant past context; after each turn it saves new insights. Memory lives in a per-agent-group directory and survives container restarts.
howto.when_en: When you mention something from earlier discussions or start a new session, Claude automatically recalls relevant memory; after each turn it also records new information. Note this only applies to agents using the default Claude provider.

say_en.text: We discussed the architecture of project X last time, let's continue.
say_en.note: This triggers Claude to recall previous memory.

say_en.text: Based on my preferences stated last week, recommend a solution.
say_en.note: Claude will retrieve relevant context from memory.

say_en.text: I just mentioned that thing earlier, do you remember?
